sentence: Responsible AI reaches competitive advantage through supply-chain justice, and complexity erodes the distributive channel while the procedural one holds
passage: [Li, Shi et al. (2026), p. 1] "Survey data from 218 Chinese firms show that responsible AI fosters both distributive and procedural justice, which in turn facilitates firms' competitive advantages. Further, we identify an asymmetric moderating effect: high supply chain complexity weakens the mediating effect of distributive but not procedural justice."

gemini.note: The passage confirms that responsible AI facilitates competitive advantage via distributive and procedural justice, and that supply chain complexity weakens only the distributive effect.
